protocol_baseline: MCP 2025-11-25; not a claim this is the latest version
method: Primary specification and pinned public-source inspection; analytical classifications, not observed product executions.

conclusion.statement: Classify packaging, interfaces, semantic roles and execution separately; these categories compose rather than replace each other.
conclusion.largest_architectural_consequence: Separate interface/deployment graphs from knowledge/execution graphs.

dimensions.question: Where are authored rules, task facts, model judgment and external knowledge dependencies?
Which host/model/runtime/server/backend actually performs the operation?
Who publishes content, maintains implementation, operates runtime and adopts authority?
Guidance, declarative, native_code, model_mediated or mixed; under which engine?
Format loading, operational prerequisites and semantic equivalence are separate.
Contract visibility, implementation visibility and actual-run evidence are separate.
What license/source availability applies to each artifact, engine, service and model?
Where should canonical content live, and which access/enforcement layers are needed?

classification_rules.unit: specific artifact/capability/operation at a revision and declared task scope
classification_rules.inherited_memberships: Only explicit is_a relations, not containment or invocation.
classification_rules.unknown_rule: No implementation evidence means unknown, not absent/proprietary/deterministic.
classification_rules.closure_rule: Self-contained describes task-specific authored dependency closure, not containment of latent model expertise or absence of runtimes.
classification_rules.gateway_rule: Specialist task answer/action is outside the bundle; generic tools or external facts alone are insufficient.
classification_rules.dependency_enriched: Annotation for local rules plus externally supplied facts/knowledge; not an exclusive skill class.
classification_rules.authority_rule: Knowledge provenance and interface access do not imply local permission or enforcement.

types.name: Agent instruction
types.necessary: Text intended to guide agent behavior, role, method or constraints.
types.not_sufficient: Any readable document, skill-like name or unenforced tool permission statement.
types.knowledge: Instruction text, referenced context and model interpretation.
types.computation: Host/model interpretation; tools only when invoked.
types.ownership: Instruction author, host/model operator and adopting user are distinct.

portability.operational: Host precedence, context and loading rules must match.

inspectability.contract: Text may be visible or hidden.
inspectability.run: Loaded context and actions require separate traces.

types.openness: Any license or private content; not determined by instruction format.

types.name: Skill
types.necessary: Agent Skills directory with required SKILL.md metadata/body; optional scripts, references and assets; compatible-host discovery.
types.not_sufficient: A function or RPC called skill; other products' homonymous formats need separate mapping.
types.knowledge: Metadata, body, optional files and external dependencies.
types.computation: Host activation and model interpretation, with optional local/remote code.
types.ownership: Bundle publisher, dependency maintainers and host operator.

portability.operational: Activation, tools, runtimes and compatibility requirements vary.
portability.semantic: Same bundle does not guarantee same model/tool outcomes.

inspectability.implementation: Optional code/dependencies may differ in visibility.
inspectability.run: Activation and execution not established by file presence.

types.openness: Open format does not fix bundle or dependency license.

types.name: Self-contained skill
types.necessary: Task-specific authored rules/references/implementation within inspected bundle for a declared scope and explicit generic runtime/input prerequisites.
types.not_sufficient: Local folder, no visible network URL, or a self-contained label; latent model knowledge is not inside bundle.
types.knowledge: Scoped authored content local; model expertise and input facts separately attributed.
types.computation: Model and/or bundled code under declared runtimes.
types.ownership: Publisher separate from runtime/library owners and operator.

portability.operational: Explicit runtime/input prerequisites and dependency closure.
portability.semantic: Conformance still needed even with closed dependencies.

inspectability.implementation: Bundled binary may still be opaque.

types.openness: Can be proprietary despite local closure.

types.name: Procedural skill
types.necessary: Ordered/conditional method, handoffs, checks or recovery steps interpreted by an agent.
types.not_sufficient: Facts alone; prose ordering is not a machine-enforced workflow.
types.knowledge: Sequence/branches local; facts and operations can be elsewhere.
types.computation: Agent/harness interprets; delegated engines perform operations.
types.ownership: Procedure author, orchestrator operator and operation owners.

portability.semantic: Interpretation and recovery can vary by host.

inspectability.run: Checklist does not prove steps ran.

types.openness: Any; procedure and invoked systems have separate terms.

types.name: Tool-backed skill
types.necessary: Explicit delegation of a substantive task operation to an identified executable/API/tool, including bundled scripts.
types.not_sufficient: Ordinary host file loading; tool use says nothing about remote or proprietary logic.
types.knowledge: Local guidance plus tool logic/data and possible external rules.
types.computation: Host/model plus local script/server or remote service.
types.ownership: Skill publisher, tool maintainer and service operator.

portability.semantic: Tool and model outcomes must be tested.

best_home: MCP only if access needs it

types.name: Gateway skill
types.necessary: External-to-bundle specialist/engine provides task-specific answer/action; local skill handles routing, input preparation and results.
types.not_sufficient: A generic library, external fact lookup or MCP mention without delegation evidence.
types.knowledge: Routing local; specialist logic/data outside bundle.
types.computation: Agent routes; specialist engine/agent executes, locally or remotely.
types.ownership: Wrapper author, specialist owner and operator can differ.

portability.operational: Specialist access, identity and service version.

inspectability.implementation: Specialist may be open or unknown.
inspectability.run: Forwarding trace may not include downstream decisions.

types.name: MCP capability
types.necessary: Exposed MCP operation/resource/prompt under negotiated support; distinguish feature flags from individual operations.
types.not_sufficient: Launch configuration or tool name; underlying engine is not the protocol.
types.computation: Server handler, downstream engine and possibly client-mediated sampling.
types.ownership: Interface publisher, implementation owner, host and service operator.

portability.semantic: Matching schemas do not imply equivalent domain outcomes.

inspectability.contract: Exposed definitions/results inspectable to authorized clients.

types.openness: Open protocol does not imply open server, data or model.

types.name: Domain package
types.necessary: Versioned distributable domain-specific rules/data/operations with consumer contract/engine and reusable operational semantics.
types.not_sufficient: Prose-only folder or MEDP label; need not contain binary, policy, every validator or agent runtime.
types.knowledge: Package domain rules/recipes/models and declared dependencies.
types.ownership: Domain publisher, engine maintainer and local adopting authority.
types.openness: Artifact-specific; machine-executable does not imply open.

types.name: Policy
types.necessary: Normative constraints/decision rules governing permitted or required behavior in identified scope.
types.not_sufficient: Descriptive fact; declaration is not adoption, authority or enforcement.
types.computation: Human/model or policy evaluator; enforcement separate.
types.ownership: Issuer, adopter, evaluator maintainer and enforcer.

portability.semantic: Different adopters legitimately yield different permission decisions.

types.openness: Private policy can use open evaluator.

types.name: Policy package
types.necessary: Versioned distributable policies/data with loading/evaluation contract.
types.not_sufficient: Evaluator itself; domain-specific machine-evaluable bundles may also be K08 but generic mechanism alone does not establish domain.
types.ownership: Bundle publisher, engine maintainer and adopting organization.

portability.semantic: Same inputs and adopted policy context required.

inspectability.run: Signatures do not prove correct decisions.

types.openness: Engine license does not determine bundle license.

types.name: Validator
types.necessary: Operation evaluating a subject against stated criteria, producing scoped results/evidence.
types.not_sufficient: Schema/checklist alone, success text without checks, or claims of universal/independent correctness.
types.knowledge: Criteria, fixtures/oracle, subject evidence and possible model judgment.
types.ownership: Criteria owner, verifier maintainer, operator and acceptance owner.

inspectability.implementation: Source visibility does not establish independence.

types.openness: Open harness may use closed oracle; artifact-specific.

types.name: Recipe
types.necessary: Named/configurable machine-interpretable search/transform operation or composition with engine semantics and applicability.
types.not_sufficient: Prose recipe; a package containing a recipe is not automatically one operation; no implicit authorization.
types.ownership: Recipe author, engine maintainer and execution approver.

portability.semantic: Applicability and side effects must match.

types.openness: Recipe and engine may carry different licenses.

examples.name: Anthropic brand-guidelines palette/typography selection
examples.scope: Select listed style values/fallbacks, not render arbitrary documents.
examples.knowledge: Listed values/fallbacks in SKILL.md; tacit agent competence separate.
examples.computation: Host/model applies text; rendering libraries/fonts outside this narrow scope.
examples.openness: Scoped skill LICENSE.txt is Apache-2.0; no claim about model or all Anthropic skills.
examples.inspectability: Pinned source visible; no actual run trace.
examples.portability_limit: Host/model adherence and rendering environment untested.

examples.name: Anthropic webapp-testing skill and helper
examples.scope: Testing workflow plus bundled server-lifecycle helper.
examples.knowledge: Procedure in skill; application assertions authored separately by agent; helper knows lifecycle.
examples.computation: Host/model authors test, Python helper manages processes, Playwright/browser executes test.
examples.inspectability: Skill/helper source inspected; no test execution observed.
examples.portability_limit: Python/browser/application state and authored oracle required.

examples.name: Modernize team-request infrastructure delegation
examples.scope: Request infrastructure info/resource action through InfrastructureExpert.
examples.knowledge: Routing and no-direct-provisioning instruction local; specialist resource knowledge external.
examples.computation: Caller routes; InfrastructureExpert performs specialist work.

ownership.authority: team/adopter configuration, not established by text

examples.openness: Inspected repository MIT; downstream implementation/service terms unknown.
examples.inspectability: Wrapper visible; specialist implementation and request protocol not established.
examples.portability_limit: Named team role and request-tool semantics required.

examples.name: Modernize MCP launch configuration
examples.scope: mcp.json entry launching package 1.24.0 using stdio.
examples.knowledge: Configuration establishes package/transport, not domain rules.
examples.computation: Local subprocess entry point declared; downstream computation unknown.
examples.openness: MIT configuration; launched package/services not license-audited here.
examples.inspectability: Launch contract visible; no advertised operation list or handler inspected.
examples.portability_limit: Runtime/package acquisition and host integration required.

examples.name: Python SDK quickstart add tool
examples.scope: One MCP tool handler, not the entire server.
examples.computation: Server directly computes a + b; no model call in handler.
examples.inspectability: Handler source visible; deployed correspondence not verified.
examples.portability_limit: SDK/runtime and MCP support; not proof of other tool semantics.

examples.name: Python SDK quickstart greet_user prompt
examples.knowledge: Style templates in server code; model would interpret returned instruction.
examples.computation: Server constructs prompt text, not a generated greeting from an LLM.
examples.inspectability: Prompt-construction source visible; actual client behavior unknown.
examples.portability_limit: Prompt feature and client use; no Skill format established.
unknowns: Whether a client later invokes a model

examples.name: Python SDK quickstart get_greeting resource
examples.portability_limit: Resource feature and URI handling; context is not an authoritative fact by category.

examples.name: Camel Upgrade Recipes library
examples.scope: Versioned native domain recipe library, not MEDP compliance.
examples.knowledge: Domain migration mappings in recipe resources/code; README documents paths and scope.
examples.computation: OpenRewrite/build tooling interprets recipes and invokes visitors.
examples.openness: Pinned library Apache-2.0; dependencies separately licensed.
examples.inspectability: Public source and documented test artifacts; no migration trace captured.
examples.portability_limit: Engine/parser/classpath versions; Camel-Quarkus excluded by README.

examples.name: OPA policy/data bundle mechanism
examples.scope: Generic bundle mechanism, not a specific adopted domain policy.
examples.computation: OPA evaluates; consuming service must enforce decision.
examples.openness: No particular bundle inspected; its license unknown.
examples.inspectability: Mechanism documented; specific rules and run trace unknown.
examples.portability_limit: Evaluator, builtins, data, revision and adopted context must match.

examples.name: Repository AGENTS.md
examples.knowledge: Conduct and constraints in Markdown; external tools enforce only their own controls.

ownership.implementation: agent host/model and invoked tool maintainers

examples.openness: Repository-visible text; no inference about all host/model internals.
examples.inspectability: Text visible; complete enforcement not proven.
examples.portability_limit: Host loading/precedence and adherence; not SKILL.md format.

examples.name: Repository validation script
examples.scope: Declared structural checks and secret scan; not full application verification.
examples.knowledge: Repository criteria in shell, jq predicates and text checks.
examples.openness: Source visible; no assertion that visibility ensures correctness.
examples.portability_limit: Utility behavior matters; current rg invocation mishandles dash-leading pattern.

actual_run.observation: Repository script prints passed while rg rejects its pattern as an option; supplemental correctly parameterized scan required.

examples.name: Skill to MCP to recipes, policy and validator
examples.scope: Illustrative composition; not a deployed integration.
examples.knowledge: Wrapper routing, recipe domain rules, policy constraints and independent criteria remain separate.
examples.computation: Host/model, server adapter, executor, recipe/policy engines and verifier.

ownership.content: separate skill, recipe, policy and criteria authors

examples.inspectability: Would require per-edge implementation and run evidence.
examples.portability_limit: MCP compatibility is weaker than recipe/policy semantic equivalence.

mcp_patterns.meaning: MCP adapter forwards to existing engine; adapter still does protocol/access work.
Handler uses own model backend or negotiated client sampling.
Serve static/dynamic data or instruction templates without necessarily deciding domain questions.

placement_rules.condition: Agent conduct, contextual explanation or one-off judgment.
placement_rules.access: Skill only if reusable discovery helps.
placement_rules.verify: Actual context loading/adherence; no hard enforcement claim.

home: workflow code when ordering/retry is mandatory
placement_rules.access: Existing native tools or MCP where appropriate.
placement_rules.verify: Failure paths and actual gate execution.
Pinned engine/dependencies, expected/no-op diffs, unsupported cases and behavior.

placement_rules.condition: Normative constraint independent of model compliance.

placement_rules.verify: Fail/skipped/error, output binding and limited coverage.

placement_rules.condition: Several agent hosts need discoverable tools/context/prompts.
home: MCP access layer over existing implementation

placement_rules.condition: Dynamic facts or restricted service-owned expertise.
placement_rules.access: Thin gateway skill for routing if useful; MCP optional.
placement_rules.verify: Freshness/provenance and exactly what rule/data was delegated.

placement_rules.condition: One local caller, simple stable computation, no discovery need.
placement_rules.access: Do not add MCP/registry by default.

placement_rules.condition: Reuse across adopters with different permissions/models.
placement_rules.access: Native and agent clients as appropriate.
placement_rules.verify: Format/operational/semantic conformance and legitimate policy differences.
